note: Which customBundler values count as set (WR-48): JavaScript-truthy ones. An unset one leaves the bundle to esbuild with the entry's other settings (WR-47, bundle.BuildCodebase). A set one fails the compile, before any build (unsupported_feature, 0001 §5a; conformance/ir/wr-48.json), since windmill-lite does not run the command (WR-48/a, deferred).

cases.title: a falsy customBundler counts as unset
cases.note: WR-48/a's fixture with customBundler: false: esbuild builds f/cb/custom.ts, so the source's own main runs, not the script the command would print. The command's file is emit.txt where the catalogue says emit.sh: a .sh file in a sync folder is a Bash script, which this release has no harness for.

folder.wmill.yaml:
defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    customBundler: false
    define: {"__X__": "1"}

defaultTs: bun
codebases:
  - relative_path: f/cb
    includes: ["f/cb/**"]
    customBundler: 0
    define: {"__X__": "1"}
